reviews.title: Better than BitLife
reviews.text: I've never done reviews, never saw the purpose, and never really felt the need to, but this game is honestly something I enjoy so much that I felt inclined to write a review. I hope this game gets more updates over time, with cooler interactions and activities that make it feel like you're playing "life." BitLife is fun, but it didn’t give me that “realism” this game simulates, and I’m sure with more updates, it will just keep getting better. Devs, if you see this, keep going. One thing I want added is unique jobs like being in the armed forces or a professional sports athlete—that’s what I want, at least.

reviews.title: Minimalistic Yet Fun
reviews.text: I absolutely love this game and I am happy to have found it. What amazed me was the social media factor and how there’s a whole crypto market in the game, it is all so detail-oriented and definitely gives the illusion of having a lot of choices and control over the lives in this game. I also love the moody, realistic, minimalist vibe this game has, it’s a breath of fresh air from Bitlife that is also excellent but has a loud and somewhat unrealistic style to it. The downside of this is that there’s not a lot of soul in the relationships you make in this game, they’re just buttons and they don’t have an appearance or a lot of personality. The happiness doesn’t even decrease when they die which is kind of unsettling. It’s like they’re not even there at all. I would also say this game would be a lot better with minigames, a test of skill every once in a while. I wanted to be reminded that it’s a game and not actual life which is depressing. Anyway it’s a good game and people should try it out!
